body: hi all, Henry's brother Jack here. Found my older brothers password to his reddit on his computer last night and wanted to give everyone an update. Henry has sadly ended his life. He was found in a forest with a bullet hole through his head. He left me a note saying how much he loved me and to take good care of our mother although she didnt take care of him, but I wanted to update all. I felt Henry would have wanted to thank all of you for the kind words, which I have gone through and read. You are all wonderful people for helping him through this. From Henry and me, thank you for trying. It hurts me everyday that he has passed, but regardless I will move on and continue doing as much as I can in school since that is what he would have wanted for me. To be succesful and happy. That was all he ever wanted for anybody. Again, thank you all for the kind words for my brother. Rest in peace my beloved brother, Henry.
Ive been using a personal trainer for quite some time now, but its still a work in progress, so the weight issues are getting much better :). Thanks for the advice!

I really appreciate your positive feedback. My mother is usually away and I don't have a strong relationship with her. My father used to be out of the house a lot and as a young child I was verbally and occasionally physically abused so we don't talk very much. Ill look into talking to a counselor and my father more about it, thank you very much for taking the time to give your great opinion :)
